title: Spiritual evidence
question: Did what the Bible promised come true, and does it change lives?
scope: Fulfilled prophecy (curated promise to fulfilment pairs) and published, attributable testimonies. Testimonies are persuasive to believers but are not proof to a sceptic, and the app says so.

title: Historical evidence
question: Do writers outside the Bible confirm its people and events?
scope: Roman and Jewish writers (Tacitus, Josephus, Pliny, Suetonius and others) and the manuscript record of the Bible itself. Disputed passages are shown with the dispute.

title: Scientific evidence
question: What do scientific methods say about the Bible's world?
scope: Laboratory dating of biblical structures and manuscripts, and arguments from cosmology. Measurements are reported as measured; arguments built on them are labelled as arguments, with the main objections.

title: Theological evidence
question: Does the Bible hold together as one story?
scope: Themes and promises that run from the Old Testament into the New, shown with the passages themselves. This is an argument from the text, not an outside proof.

title: Archaeological evidence
question: Has the ground confirmed the Bible's people and places?
scope: Inscriptions, seals, tablets, scrolls and excavated buildings, with where they were found, where they are now and what they do not show.

title: Geographical evidence
question: Where did it happen? Can I see it on a map?
scope: All 1,298 Theographic places with coordinates on a map, plus curated histories of iconic sites and tombs from Genesis to Revelation. Each says whether the identification rests on excavation or on tradition.
